items.title: Terminal2Shell: Critical flaw grants instant shell access on every major OS
items.summary: What is Terminal2Shell? Terminal2Shell is a design-level vulnerability in terminal emulators. When a terminal is launched, it immediately spawns a shell process and connects it directly to the user's keyboard.
